summary: Nano-X Imaging furnished a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that its 2026 Annual General Meeting lacked a quorum, as holders of less than 25% of voting rights were present, and was adjourned without conducting business. A proxy supplement, dated September 17, 2026, supplements the August 18, 2026 proxy statement; the reconvened meeting is set for Tuesday, September 29, 2026, 3:00 p.m. Israel time, where any present holders constitute a quorum. Proposal 3, two equity grants to CEO Erez Meltzer, was withdrawn at his request to focus on Proposal 2.
